purpose: local-only first-pass identification of FireSpread_MedEU v2 events spatially overlapping Bosnia and Herzegovina; not an event selection, perimeter validation, or simulator replay

dataset.name: FireSpread_MedEU
dataset.license_status: Zenodo v2 record marks the dataset Open but shows no license value; do not redistribute or assume article CC-BY-4.0 also licenses the data package.

boundary.name: Natural Earth Admin 0 countries
boundary.limitation: Coarse national boundary; use only for candidate discovery, then verify coordinates against authoritative/high-resolution boundaries and the EFFIS record.

fuel_map.name: EFFIS European Fuel Map
fuel_map.license: EFFIS states EU-owned site content is CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise indicated; cite the European Fuel Map (2017) and indicate processing changes.
fuel_map.fuel_model_system: NFFL / Anderson 1982 categories; EFFIS says 42 vegetation complexes were assigned to 13 categories, with the final 3 categories unused. Local raster contains codes 1-10.
fuel_map.limitation: This is a 250m continental classification, not a local fuel inventory; it uses NFFL model categories and is not directly compatible with the current Canadian FBP Cell2Fire implementation. No terrain or weather is bundled.

method.geometry_repair: Two invalid non-empty geometries, belonging to EFFIS IDs 51305 and 51382 outside the Bosnia and Herzegovina subset, were repaired in memory with shapely.make_valid for the overlay. The source ZIP was not changed.

first_local_reference_candidate.reason: Four consecutive daily burned-area steps, all rated very high in the dataset, 2022-07-15 through 2022-07-18.
first_local_reference_candidate.important_scale_limit: Its final mapped extent is about 4.14 by 4.18 km. The verified 20x20, 100 m Firehose policy covers only 2 by 2 km (400 ha); it cannot contain or score the complete event.

smallest_spatial_candidate.reason: Smallest final mapped area among the seven candidates (216.87 ha).
smallest_spatial_candidate.important_scale_limit: Its final bounding extent is about 2.56 by 1.71 km, so it also does not fit inside the existing 2 by 2 km policy window without cropping or changing grid scale. One propagation step is medium quality.

interpretation: These are seven first-pass spatial overlaps, not independently checked national fire labels or a representative sample of all BiH fires.
EFFIS_id and satellite-derived perimeters provide event/progression evidence; they do not provide complete historical fuel, terrain, local hourly weather, or suppression inputs.

The available Cell2Fire policy uses Canadian FBP classes. FireSpread_MedEU LCCS land-cover fractions must not be relabeled into Canadian FBP codes without an independently justified fuel/spread model.
The historical boundary is for no-action/model replay; it is not an action label and cannot reveal a counterfactual RL-controlled outcome.
